resources.string: Boar Canvas
Turn an answer into a card to read at a glance, or a small tool to play with. Made on this phone, offline.
Some answers read better as a picture or work better as a tool. Under any answer, open 🧩 and pick one. The model that answered makes it from the answer, after the answer is done.
📊 Card: a table, a bar chart, steps, a side-by-side comparison or key facts, drawn by BOAR.
🧪 Widget: a small interactive page, like a converter, a quiz or a slider. Small models often get these wrong; bigger models do better.

Cards use only what the answer says: a chart with a number the answer doesn\'t have is thrown away. Widgets run locked: no internet, no files, no access to BOAR or your chats. Nothing for health or seed-phrase questions.
For example, from an answer about the highest mountains:
Highest peaks
The idea comes from CopilotKit\'s Open Intelligent UI (MIT). Here it runs on your phone with no server.
